name: Sprites
description: Runs each workspace in its own Sprite, a persistent Linux VM from Fly.io: builds the Sprite, starts orca serve as a service, sleeps it on suspend and destroys it on delete.
create: bash -c 's="$(printf %s  | base64 --decode | gunzip -c)" && [ -n "$s" ] || { echo "[sprites] error: could not unpack the recipe script" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash -c "$s" "$0"' sprites-create
suspend: bash -c 's="$(printf %s  | base64 --decode | gunzip -c)" && [ -n "$s" ] || { echo "[sprites] error: could not unpack the recipe script" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash -c "$s" "$0"' sprites-suspend
resume: bash -c 's="$(printf %s  | base64 --decode | gunzip -c)" && [ -n "$s" ] || { echo "[sprites] error: could not unpack the recipe script" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash -c "$s" "$0"' sprites-resume
destroy: bash -c 's="$(printf %s  | base64 --decode | gunzip -c)" && [ -n "$s" ] || { echo "[sprites] error: could not unpack the recipe script" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash -c "$s" "$0"' sprites-destroy
